resources.string: Explain
Shows which of your accounts sends messages in this chat. It does not switch accounts.
Opens the actions that are not pinned to the toolbar, including Customize composer.
Opens the emoji picker, including your custom emoji.
Pastes what you copied into the message.
Types what you say using Android speech recognition. White Noise asks for offline recognition, but your device may still use an online service.
Turns translate mode on or off. While it is on, Send delivers the translation shown on the Will send line, and nothing is sent until a translation is ready.
Hold to record a voice message.
Opens the camera so you can attach a new photo. Android asks for camera access the first time.
Opens the Android photo picker. White Noise only receives the photos and videos you choose.
Opens the Android file picker to attach any file.
Sends your current location once, as a map link. It does not keep sharing your location.
Shares a White Noise user\'s public key as text, so others can message them.
Shares a contact card from your phone\'s contacts.
Creates a poll that group members can vote in.
Opens your stickers so you can send one.
Choose which shortcuts stay on the toolbar, which side they sit on, and where the voice message button goes.
Your profile, the keys that prove who you are, and the relays that carry your messages.
Sounds and vibration, background delivery, and Android\'s notification settings for White Noise.
Folders, swipe actions, the composer, the Enter key, custom emoji and quick account switching.
Theme, colors, font, text size, and how dates and times are shown.
App language, Read Aloud, dictation and message translation.
App lock, screen security, incognito keyboard, blocked users, default disappearing messages and diagnostics sharing.
See what uses storage, and choose when media downloads and the quality it is sent at.
Connect AI agents that you can chat with in White Noise, or set one up manually.
Help articles, chat with support, donations and developer tools.
